en: The image is a vintage postcard from 1907. The front of the postcard features a black and white photograph of a neoclassical building with the caption 'Pyrmont 1907 Schauspielhaus.' There is a statue (bust) on a pedestal in the foreground, benches, period-clad people, and lush trees. The reverse side of the postcard includes ornate cursive handwriting, addressing, and a 10 pfennig red German stamp marked 'Deutsches Reich,' with a postmark partially legible as 'Pyrmont.' The address is to Copenhagen, Denmark.
